name: School of Evocation
summary: Blasters who shape fire, lightning and force.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.short: Copy evocation spells for half the time and gold.
features.summary: The gold and time you must spend to copy a evocation spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.short: Protect allies from your area evocation spells.
features.summary: When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 + the spell's level: they automatically succeed on their saves and take no damage if they would take half.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.short: Creatures that save against your cantrips still take half damage.
features.summary: When a creature succeeds on a saving throw against your cantrip, it takes half the cantrip's damage (if any) but suffers no other effect.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.short: Add INT to one damage roll of wizard evocation spells.
features.summary: You can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any wizard evocation spell you cast.

features.name: Overchannel
features.short: Maximize damage of a 1st-5th level spell (painful when repeated).
features.summary: When you cast a wizard spell of 1st through 5th level that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage. The first use per long rest is free; later uses before a rest deal necrotic damage to you that grows each time.
